content:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Incident detected: elevated tail latency and memory pressure on inference-pool-us-west-2. Auto-alert triggered by kv_cache_size_shard > 95th percentile for 3min.
sam: seeing huge KV cache growth, looks correlated with continuous-batching rollout a few minutes ago.  heap growth on gpu-12 nodes.
maya: confirmed. graphs show kv_cache_bytes per-shard spiking from ~200MB to >1.2GB in 5m. p99 latency climbed from 80ms -> 1.2s for long-context routes.
jon: tagging the config rollout: continuous-batcher v2 default config landed in prod at 1834506400. suspect defaults too permissive (max_batch_tokens / max_num_seqs).
priya: quick check of the k8s ConfigMap: 
```
continuous_batcher:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_tokens: 10000
  max_num_seqs: 128
  max_wait_ms: 50
```
This was the change from the PR.
ops-tim: those max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs are way higher than our production guardrails (we usually cap at 2k / 16). that would explain the KV cache blowup and long-lived batches.
elena: we are seeing OOMs on a couple dedicated nodes and downstream timeouts from the API gateway. customer error rate up for streaming endpoints.
sam: mitigation plan — immediate rollback of the config to previous safe values, and purge KV cache for hot shards. who can apply?
maya: i can patch the configmap now to revert to 1024 / 8 and restart the batcher pods with zero-downtime rolling restart. doing it in staging first then prod? time is critical, I'd rather do prod patch with coordinated restart.
jon: agree. do patch+restart in prod. also trigger a manual purge endpoint to evict large prefixes while restart goes. admin endpoint: POST https://admin.prod.internal/v1/kv/purge?shard=<shard_id>
priya: executing patch: 
```
kubectl -n inference set configmap continuous-batcher-config --from-literal=max_batch_tokens=1024 --from-literal=max_num_seqs=8
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/continuous-batcher
```
Applying now (1834506942).
ops-tim: calling purge on top 5 shards with largest kv_cache_bytes (ids: s-12,s-47,s-51,s-63,s-99). purge responses: 202 accepted.
elena: restart progress: pods on node gpu-12 restarted, memory dropping. latency p99 trending back down.
incident-bot: PD page created: PD-INC-4712. on-call: @sam. escalation to SRE level 2.
sam: assigning temporary mitigation label and customer-impact scope. checking error logs for customers with increased 500s.
maya: short customer list with elevated errors: acme-corp (doc-generation pipeline), docscribe (embedding-heavy routes). both on dedicated. notified account teams.
priya: rollback completed at 1834507055. continuous-batcher pods back to normal. kv_cache_bytes per-shard returning to baseline over next 6m.
jon: follow up hotfix PR to add server-side validation to reject max_batch_tokens > 4096 and max_num_seqs > 32 in config validation. also add a feature flag to prevent silent large-rollouts.
ops-tim: we should add alerting rule: kv_cache_size_per_shard > 512MB sustained for 2m AND p99_latency > 500ms -> page oncall.
elena: customer impact summary draft: ~18 minutes of elevated latency/5xxs for two customers, one OOM on a dedicated node causing 2 in-flight requests to fail. initial estimate: ~0.04% error increase across total traffic.
sam: handing off to night on-call: @maya will take 2hr watch then hand to @ops-tim at 21:00 UTC. create postmortem stub, assign owner.
maya: creating postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PD-INC-4712 (will link logs/graphs).
priya: immediate actions done: revert config, purge top shards, restart batcher.
jon: action items for postmortem: (1) config validation guardrails (PR in review), (2) add automated cache eviction policy for runaway batch sizes, (3) revert-safe rollout gating + canary metric checks, (4) add per-customer blast radius isolation for dedicated clusters.
ops-tim: timeline note: initial rollout 1834506400, spike detected 1834506700, mitigation started 1834506942, rollback complete 1834507055, recovery steady 1834507370. total incident ~30m from detection to stable.
elena: tagging SEs for acme/docscribe with mitigation notes and support bundle export.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Postmortem owner required within 24h.
sam: i'll own the postmortem and draft mitigation code. closing slack thread once doc is linked. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
